effects.does: Clicking it opens Clara to help generate or manage RFP questions.
effects.affects: It can generate technical-stage questions only when the event has line items.
effects.check: With at least one line item, verify that clicking the button opens Clara and starts the RFP-question request.

effects.does: Clicking it opens the attachment picker.
effects.affects: It adds selected files to the event configuration.
effects.check: Select a file and verify that it appears as an attachment on the event.

effects.does: Clicking it opens the terms-and-conditions editor.
effects.affects: It changes the event's terms and conditions, which are later submitted with the event.
effects.check: Enter terms, save them, and verify that the terms remain attached to the event.

effects.does: Clicking it opens the line-item management view.
effects.affects: It allows the event's line-item records to be added or edited.
effects.leadsTo: Manage Line Items drawer or screen.
effects.check: Verify that the line-item manager opens and that the count changes after adding an item.

effects.does: It remains disabled and cannot be clicked.
effects.affects: It prevents saving the current event as a draft while the required setup is incomplete.
effects.check: Verify that the button is disabled and that clicking it produces no action.

effects.does: Clicking it validates the event and publishes it when all required data is present.
effects.affects: It changes the event from creation data to a published event and starts the configured sourcing flow.
effects.leadsTo: Published event state or the event details screen.
effects.check: Complete all required fields and verify that clicking Publish creates the event or shows the relevant validation error.

effects.does: Clicking it opens the Technical Stage configuration or strategy view.
effects.affects: It changes the selected technical-stage configuration, including its stage settings and potentially its title.
effects.check: Click the control and verify that the technical-stage configuration drawer opens.

effects.does: It is disabled and cannot be used to select a template.
effects.affects: It prevents template selection until the required line-item or stage-template conditions are met.
effects.check: Hover over the disabled control and verify that the tooltip explains that a template or line item is required.

effects.does: Clicking it opens evaluator selection.
effects.affects: It assigns an evaluator to the technical stage or its line-item sections.
effects.check: Select an evaluator and verify that the evaluator is displayed on the technical stage.

effects.does: Clicking it opens participant management.
effects.affects: It changes the event's invited vendor or participant records.
effects.check: Add a vendor and verify that the vendor appears in the participant list.

effects.does: Clicking it opens the terms-and-conditions settings.
effects.affects: It changes the event's terms and conditions, including payment terms when applicable.
effects.check: Save terms and verify that they are shown when the drawer is reopened.

effects.does: Clicking it opens the event schedule editor.
effects.affects: It changes the stage start time, end time, duration, or recurrence settings.
effects.check: Change the duration and verify that the displayed event timing updates.

effects.does: Selecting it displays the Technical Stage configuration and keeps it marked as the active stage.
effects.affects: It changes only the currently viewed stage, not the event records.
effects.check: Verify that the Technical Stage tab is highlighted and its fields are visible.

effects.does: Selecting it switches the builder to the RFQ stage.
effects.affects: It changes the active stage being configured without changing the other stage's saved data.
effects.check: Click RFQ and verify that the RFQ configuration fields replace the technical-stage fields.

effects.does: Clicking it navigates to the events list.
effects.affects: nothing
effects.check: Click the link and verify that the events listing page opens.

effects.control: Enter the title of the project
effects.does: Entering text in it updates the project title.
effects.affects: It changes the event group's title used during draft saving and publishing.
effects.check: Enter a title and verify that the value remains in the field and is used in the publish validation.

effects.control: Search vendors you want to add
effects.does: Typing in it searches for vendors and selecting a result adds that vendor as a participant.
effects.affects: It changes the event's participant or audience-company records.
effects.leadsTo: Vendor search results or the participant list.
effects.check: Search for an eligible vendor, select it, and verify that it appears as a participant while blocked vendors cannot be selected.

cases.title: Select Templates is blocked until a line item is added
steps: Click "Items 0" and add one line item.
Return to the Vendor Assessment screen.
cases.expected: Before a line item is added, "Select Templates" is disabled and shows the tooltip "Please add line items". After a line item is added, the control is enabled or its disabled tooltip is no longer shown.

cases.title: Publish reports missing payment terms
cases.expected: The event is not published. The message "Payment Terms and Conditions are mandatory" appears.
cases.setup: Prepare a valid event with a title, line items, participants, and required evaluators. Do not save payment terms.
gaps: Configure Payment Terms and Conditions or explicitly set them to an incomplete state before publishing
Configure or bypass tenant-specific mandatory savings and other publish gates that could prevent the payment-terms message from being reached

cases.title: Publish opens the event confirmation dialog
cases.expected: A confirmation dialog opens with the title "Publish Event" and an action labeled "Publish". The event has not yet been created.
cases.setup: Prepare a valid event with a project title, line items, participants, evaluators, and saved payment terms.
gaps: Directly verify through the backend that no event record has been created yet.

cases.title: Add Attachments opens the attachment interface
cases.expected: The attachment interface opens, allowing the tester to select or add an attachment. The Vendor Assessment screen remains available after closing the interface.
cases.setup: Remain on the Vendor Assessment screen.
gaps: Selecting or adding an attachment within the attachment interface
